title: Sharks Are Older Than Trees (and the Dinosaurs)

scenes.text: Sharks have been swimming in the oceans for about 450 million years.
The first real trees didn't appear until around 390 million years ago.
So for roughly 60 million years, sharks ruled the seas while the land had nothing taller than moss.
They're older than the dinosaurs, older than Saturn's rings, and they survived all five mass extinctions.
Trees are the newcomers. Sharks were here first.

description:
Sharks have existed for about 450 million years. Trees only showed up around 390 million years ago.
That makes sharks older than trees, older than dinosaurs, and survivors of every mass extinction.
Which animal do you think is next on the list?
